question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo makadamija oreščke?

answer.en: No, they are not a cat food. Cats Protection lists nuts, including macadamia, among foods to keep away from cats because their high oil and fat content can make cats unwell. Macadamia poisoning is described in dogs; if your cat eats some, ask your vet for advice.
answer.sl: Ne, niso hrana za mačke. Cats Protection makadamijo in druge oreščke uvršča med živila, ki naj bodo stran od mačk, ker jih zaradi veliko olj in maščob lahko razbolijo. Zastrupitev z makadamijo je opisana pri psih; če jih muca poje, se posvetujte z veterinarjem.

why.en: Macadamia nuts are high in oils and fats, which can make cats unwell. The ASPCA and the Merck Veterinary Manual describe macadamia poisoning in dogs, and we found no A/B source describing the same poisoning in cats. We therefore list macadamia as not recommended, not as toxic, and will update this if cat evidence appears.
why.sl: Makadamija oreščki vsebujejo veliko olj in maščob, ki lahko mačko razbolijo. ASPCA in Merckov veterinarski priročnik opisujeta zastrupitev z makadamijo pri psih, vira A/B, ki bi enako zastrupitev opisal pri mačkah, pa nismo našli. Zato makadamijo uvrščamo med odsvetovana, ne strupena živila, in podatek posodobimo, če se pojavijo dokazi pri mačkah.

en: Signs of an upset stomach or feeling unwell (our sources do not list specific signs in cats)
sl: Znaki prebavnih težav ali slabega počutja (naši viri ne navajajo posebnih znakov pri mačkah)

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate macadamia nuts, contact your vet for advice. Note how many she ate and when, and keep the packaging.
what_to_do.sl: Če je muca pojedla makadamija oreščke, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja. Zapišite, koliko jih je pojedla in kdaj, ter shranite embalažo.

child.en: Nuts are a people snack. They are too oily for cats, so keep the bowl out of kitty's reach.
child.sl: Oreščki so priboljšek za ljudi. Za muce so premastni, zato skledo postavi izven mucinega dosega.

q.en: Why do some lists call macadamia nuts toxic?
q.sl: Zakaj jih nekateri seznami označujejo kot strupene?

a.en: Macadamia nuts can cause weakness, tremors and other signs in dogs. Cats Protection advises keeping all nuts, including macadamia, away from cats because their fat can make cats unwell.
a.sl: Makadamija oreščki lahko pri psih povzročijo šibkost, tresenje in druge znake. Cats Protection svetuje, naj bodo vsi oreščki, tudi makadamija, stran od mačk, ker jih maščobe lahko razbolijo.

sources.quote: Nuts such as macadamia, almonds and walnuts contain high amounts of oils and fats which if eaten can make your cat unwell
Macadamia nuts can cause weakness, incoordination, depression, vomiting, tremors and hyperthermia in dogs.
If you notice or suspect your cat has eaten food that can be harmful to them, book an urgent appointment with your vet
If possible, take the packaging, plant, or substance with you to the veterinary clinic
